correctness.rationale: Exhaustive sign-case algebra shows H(x,y)=(|x|-y,x-|y|) satisfies H^5≡0. Its 2-Lipschitz estimate and five translations c=(-3,1) imply F^5(R²)⊂[-93,93]² via 3∑_{j=0}^4 2^j=93. Independently executed the inspected exact-rational polyhedral clipping program and confirmed 9 image counts 4,13,21,29,33,31,28,23,18; final 18 sets consist of five points and thirteen segments each included in one edge of G. On the horizontal segment F² has branches g(t)=-2t-5,-1,-2t-1,-5, leaving only -1, (-5,5) and (-3,1) recurrent, which lift to the claimed fixed and four-cycles. Bounded alternating orbit forces t=-3 by g²(t)=4t+9. Recurrence under invariant Borel probability forces support on these cycles.
residual_risks: Finite graph collapse in 14 steps is NOT the same as uniformly bounded eventual settling; near repelling cycle transient lengths diverge.
